title: ingest.object.created payload (v1)
description: Payload of the ingest.object.created outbox event. vault_sync emits canonical lifecycle identity in uuid/object_id and retained frontmatter continuity in vault_uuid; other producers retain their documented shapes. Consumer app/services/indexer.py reads fields defensively. The schema remains open for producer-specific extras.

uuid.description: Canonical lifecycle object id for vault_sync events.

vault_uuid.description: Retained frontmatter continuity identity when available.
